## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request does, why it is needed, and link any related issues.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance / Refactoring

## Ethical & Contract Compliance Checklist
- [ ] **Human-in-the-loop**: Does not allow AI models to auto-resolve or close hotspots without human sign-off.
- [ ] **Zero Blame Attribution**: Does not introduce fields, queries, or UI elements tracking individual blame or culprit identification.
- [ ] **Contract Integrity**: All API changes match schemas in `backend/app/schemas.py`.
- [ ] **Build & Tests**: Verified with `npm run build` (frontend) and pytest (backend).
